tooltips.addInstance: Register another VPN instance on this server (e.g. a second WireGuard interface for a different site)
tooltips.installVpn: Install a new VPN on this server
tooltips.editLabel: Set a friendly name for the self-service portal (e.g. "Germany")
tooltips.editDescription: Note for portal users — what this VPN is for (e.g. "home network, egress blocked")
tooltips.removeConfirmDescription: The software on the host is not removed, it just stops being managed by the panel.
tooltips.confirmStop: Stop the "{{label}}" service? All current connections to this VPN will drop.

status.label: Status
status.tip: UP means the VPN interface is installed and up on the host; the number is how many clients are currently online out of the total configured

portalVisible.label: Visible to users
portalVisible.tip: While disabled, this instance isn't visible in the self-service portal at all — a user won't even be able to request access to it. Enable it to show it in the portal (greyed out until access is approved).

add.checkDescription: First we'll check (and install if needed) the required software on this server -- only after that can the rest of the settings be entered. This way a provider never sits in the list half-configured.
add.title: Add VPN instance
add.description: Software already checked/installed. Fill in the settings -- saving brings the provider up on the server right away.

relabel.title: Friendly name
relabel.description: Shown to self-service portal users instead of the instance's technical name. Leave empty to fall back to the technical name.

redescribe.title: Portal description
redescribe.description: A short note about what this VPN is for — e.g. "home network, internet egress blocked", "backup slow connection", "bypasses blocks, not part of the internal network". Shown to portal users next to the name. Leave empty to show no note.

form.localNamePattern: lowercase, must start with a letter
form.label: Friendly name (for the self-service portal)
form.labelTooltip: Shown to portal users instead of the instance's technical name — e.g. "Germany" instead of "wg1". Can be set later.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: home network, internet egress blocked
form.addressTooltip: This VPN interface's address and subnet, e.g. 10.10.0.1/24 -- required, the interface won't come up without it. Can be changed later on the Settings tab.
form.wgPortTooltip: The port this interface will listen on. Empty = WireGuard picks a random port itself. Must be free on this server.
